label: Dei Filius IMMENSE_2 and INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 from the nine, with sense bridges to the primitives
summary: Follow-up to attempts b93ce632 and 28296836 (#1483, lord and most blessed): typed siblings for the last two Dei Filius primitives, Primitives.Immense and Primitives.Incomprehensible. The primitives stay (IMMENSE_1, INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1); typed SIBLING readings are added and not identified with them (disambiguations 3fc3ee02 IMMENSE and d63d0696 INCOMPREHENSIBLE). IMMENSE_2 (definition 641c767b, IsImmenseAsInfiniteCauseOfAll): g is INFINITE_1 and causes the being of everything else (q.7 a.1; q.8 a.3 gives causing being as the GROUND of presence by essence; IMMENSE_2 types causing being, tenselessly, not presence, and is a typed proxy for Aquinas's grounds, not a sense in which Dei Filius calls God immense). INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 (definition 94ebe0d2, IsIncomprehensibleToCausedIntellects): g is INFINITE_1 and no caused intellect (80dea550: has intellect and some other being causes its being) comprehends g. Comprehension needed one new explicitly identified primitive relation, Comprehension.Comprehends (4afe4ab4: knows as perfectly as knowable, q.12 a.7): truth related and a search of TruthCore found no relation between a knower and a known being (Veracity.Knows in NamingVeracityBatch1 is propositional; the q.103 UnmovedDirectorKnowsAndUnderstands uses unary cognition predicates; the understanding respect 39f50105 is a respect of act, not a relation to an object). RESULTS (spec specs/dei-filius-immense-incomprehensible.toml, all Comparator-verified, zero axioms): (1) every being with the nine is IMMENSE_2 with NO premise: infinity is one of the nine and the creator conjunct is contained BY DEFINITION in supreme goodness; this is a definitional unfolding, not an independent warrant, so all substantive content of immensity sits in the sense bridge 8bf775e9; (2) every being with the nine is INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 from two new open bridges, 18ca6f9d (what is caused as to being by another is not INFINITE_1, after q.7 a.2) and bbac932e (no intellect that is not INFINITE_1 comprehends an INFINITE_1 being, after q.12 a.7); (3) strength order: the old bridges c7c32f20 and fa3f08a8 entail the new sense bridges 8bf775e9 (IMMENSE_2 -> IMMENSE_1) and 0042dd05 (INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 -> INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1), strictly (controls parts 2-3), registered as strengthens relations; the six older Dei Filius routes that use the old bridges record strong_version_needed (their frozen Challenges take the strong versions; for immensity the infinity conjunct is available there, so the strong version is not needed in substance, only by registration), and so do the two LORD_2/BLESSED_2 routes of #1483 (ad8e261e, ec8182d6); conversely the two new routes record strong_version_needed for the old lord and blessed bridges bb3d4417 and dc3ec456, which they keep; (4) further routes for 5fbea2f5 and c0f4a346 with immense and incomprehensible through IMMENSE_2/INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 and the two sense bridges (listed in sense_bridges), composing the registered nineGiveDeiFilius and deiFiliusRoot on modified primitives; (5) controls: nonvacuity (with a being that comprehends itself, so INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 allows self-comprehension; that it is not unknowability follows from the form of its definition, which negates only Comprehends and types no knowing relation), strictness of both sense bridges, need for each of the two new bridges, sense-mixing control. These routes use the old lord and blessed bridges; they do not compose with the LORD_2/BLESSED_2 routes of #1483 (a joint route through all four typed senses is a mechanical next step). WHERE THE CONTENT NOW SITS. Immense: the sense bridge 8bf775e9 carries place, containment and measure (not contained by place, q.8 a.2, a.4), presence by power and by knowledge (the other two modes of q.8 a.3), the q.8 a.1 contact principle (an agent is joined to that on which it acts), sustaining as against merely originating causation (q.104 a.1; CausesIn esse is tenseless, DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION) and immediacy of presence (CausesIn does not distinguish mediate from immediate). Its antecedent does not say the being is incorporeal, so 'not contained by place' rests on infinity alone in the bridge (in the routes the being is also simple). Incomprehensible: the sense bridge 0042dd05 is close to analytic given the stated glosses (Comprehends is glossed as knowing as perfectly as knowable, and a created intellect is a caused one); the substantive warrant now sits in 18ca6f9d and bbac932e. The derivation of INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 uses only the infinity of the nine, and given infinity, 18ca6f9d, bbac932e and 0042dd05 jointly entail the old bridge fa3f08a8 for any Comprehends, CausesIn and HasIntellect: the new route splits the old commitment into finer premises, not a weaker total commitment (the strength relation 499fdd58 concerns the sense bridge alone; the infinity conjunct of 94ebe0d2 is partly a convenience for that order). OBJECTION AUDIT (substantive objection standard, both directions). Immense sense bridge 8bf775e9: lead 'an immaterial being cannot be present anywhere, since presence requires location'; target the bridge; mechanism: spatial presence presupposes location; this targets a spatial reading of presence the bridge does not use (presence through causing being, q.8 a.1-2), and no independent justification that all presence is spatial is on file; recorded as a lead. EXISTENTIAL INERTIA, classified SUBSTANTIVE (after the independent semantic challenge): target this bridge with CausesIn read as originating causation; mechanism: if things once caused persist without concurrent sustaining causation, an originating cause of the being of all need not now be present to anything; independent justification: Schmid 2021 (pinned and read, attempt conservation-existential-inertia-rival, docs/eternity-dependence-connection.md) explains persistence by earlier existence plus the absence of destructive causal change; relevance: the bridge itself carries the sustaining step. A rival framework, not an established counterexample; Feser 2021 (also read) contests past-state sufficiency; on the sustaining reading the dispute moves to conservation (q.104 a.1), which remains open. A Spinozist God (infinite immanent cause of all) satisfies IMMENSE_2 and plausibly IMMENSE_1; that bears on the distinctness attribute (RemoteFromAll, already recorded), not on this bridge. Caused-is-not-infinite 18ca6f9d: scope point internal to the case: read with the divine processions as instances of causing being, it would contradict the Nicene teaching that the Son, from the Father, is infinite; the answer rests on an explicit domain stipulation, now recorded as a scope condition (definition 80dea550, statement 18ca6f9d) binding every premise sharing this Being and CausesIn: elements are individuated by their act of being, so the divine persons, one in numerically identical esse, are one element and cannot be represented as distinct elements; the Son's esse is not received into a distinct receiving potency (the q.7 a.2 qualification; q.7 a.2 ad 1: against the nature of a made thing to be absolutely infinite). That q.33 a.1 ad 1 prefers 'principle' to 'cause' is only a terminological aside (it notes the Greeks say 'cause'). q.7 a.2's relative infinity of created things (secundum quid) is not INFINITE_1. No substantive objection identified. Finite-intellect bridge bbac932e: lead 'finite minds grasp infinite objects through finite principles (a finite definition fixes the natural numbers)'; target its mechanism (finite power cannot know the infinite as much as knowable); independent justification exists for quantitative infinities (INFINITE_2) but the relevance to INFINITE_1 (unlimited act, not quantity) is not shown, and whether a finite definition is knowing an object as perfectly as knowable is the contested point (incompleteness even cuts toward finite minds not comprehending the natural numbers); recorded as a lead, no substantive objection identified. The bridge also carries the step from finite being to finite power of knowing. Incomprehensible sense bridge 0042dd05: apophatic/cataphatic tension: both senses negate comprehension only, so neither conflicts with DS 3004 (God knowable with certainty by natural reason) and neither asserts radical apophaticism (God not known at all), which would be a stronger thesis and is no premise here. No substantive objection identified. WARRANT AUDIT: no claim states any new bridge or sense bridge; q.7 a.1-2, q.8 a.1-4, q.12 a.7 and q.33 a.1 ad 1 are cited as attributed motivation without pinned readings (logic first, attribution deferred). Joint satisfiability of each new route's whole premise bundle is not checked (unresolved); the controls witness the new premises together with the nine only. No premise is established.
blocker: Not blocked. Next tests: (0) type sustaining as against originating causing of being (a time- or dependence-indexed CausesIn) so the existential-inertia objection to the immensity sense bridge can be stated against a typed premise; (1) compose one route through all four typed senses (LORD_2, BLESSED_2, IMMENSE_2, INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2), now that #1483 is merged; (2) add incorporeality (IsSpiritual, from simplicity and the q.3 a.7 matter-form clause) to IMMENSE_2's antecedent and type 'not contained by place' with a place relation, so the immensity sense bridge carries less; type presence by power (each thing subject to g's active power) in the Power vocabulary; (3) define Comprehends from a typed measure of knowability (q.12 a.1: knowable insofar as in act, so an INFINITE_1 being is knowable in every respect of act) and an intellect's power of knowing, so that bbac932e can be derived or fail; (4) derive 18ca6f9d from received esse (ReceptionLimitation: ReceivedEsseIsLimited) with a bridge from caused to received being and from limited to not INFINITE_1; (5) check joint satisfiability of the new routes' premise bundles with a model.
